summary: Harden #648 across bug/feature loops: entering human_checkpoint auto-opens a durable checkpoint; advance to merge_eligible requires approve; packets expose decide ask_user_question options.
migration_impact: Bug and Feature loop advance at human_checkpoint now creates .agentic/checkpoints records (or under test base_dir/checkpoints) and blocks leave until plate_checkpoint_decide approve. force_skip_checkpoint still bypasses for low-risk paths.
migration_guidance: 2. On high-risk bug/feature loops: advance into human_checkpoint (auto-opens cp-*).
3. User decides via plate_checkpoint_decide / gh plate checkpoint --decide ID --decision approve (or feed options).
4. Re-advance the loop to merge_eligible only after approval; do not merge while pending.
agent_notes: Prefer the checkpoint_id on the loop run over ad-hoc comments. force_skip_checkpoint is only for explicit low-risk skip paths. Feed/TUI hosts should present packet ask_user_question approve/reject options at human_checkpoint.
